scripts.build: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run check:prose && pnpm run check:links && fumadocs-mdx && next build
scripts.dev: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run check:prose && pnpm run check:links && next dev --port 3000
scripts.test: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run check:prose && pnpm run check:links && node --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run check:prose && pnpm run check:links && fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.postinstall: pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run check:prose && pnpm run check:links && fumadocs-mdx
